title: SRS-107.2: reach all recorded sign-ins with stable pagination
summary: Adds cursor pagination and Load older sign-ins. Equal timestamps are ordered by numeric history ID; concurrent new sign-ins do not skip or duplicate older pages. Depends on SRS-107.1.

title: SRS-107.3: display recorded login dates in the viewer timezone
summary: Displays the stored sign-in date for every history entry. Tests cover midnight boundaries and leap days; no timestamp is replaced with today. Depends on SRS-107.1 and 107.2.

title: SRS-107.4: show recorded login times and timezone context
summary: Displays stored sign-in time including seconds and timezone. Date and time use the same browser timezone; tests distinguish repeated daylight-saving hours. Depends on SRS-107.1–107.3.

title: SRS-107.6: identify active, ended and current sessions
summary: Derives session status from actual provider sessions, persisted expiry and the existing application revocation cutoff/preserved-session rule. Marks the verified current session without returning provider session IDs or tokens. Depends on SRS-107.1–107.4.
